move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this project matters beyond the immediate order. We value that relationship and recognise that dependable, on-time payment matters to making it work. What price improvement could you offer in return for faster payment?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.70 per unit, 45 days payment, 28 days lead time; EUR 28.61 per unit, 30 days payment, 28 days lead time; EUR 28.51 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
Just write if something is unclear.
Gruß
